WITH web_v1 as (
    SELECT ws_item_sk item_sk, d_date, SUM(ws_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY ws_item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cume_sales
    FROM web_sales 
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1212 and 1212+11
    WHERE ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
), store_v1 as (
    SELECT ss_item_sk item_sk, d_date, SUM(ss_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cume_sales
    FROM store_sales 
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1212 and 1212+11
    WHERE ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(web.item_sk, store.item_sk) item_sk, COALESCE(web.d_date, store.d_date) d_date, web.cume_sales web_sales, store.cume_sales store_sales
    FROM web_v1 web 
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_v1 store ON (web.item_sk = store.item_sk AND web.d_date = store.d_date)
) x
WHERE COALESCE(x.cume_sales,0) > COALESCE((SELECT cume_sales FROM store_v1 WHERE item_sk = x.item_sk AND d_date = x.d_date), 0)
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date LIMIT 100
